insulspan.title: Insulspan® Insulated Roofing Panels
insulspan.description: Structural insulated roofing panels with up to 8.1m clear span, pre-finished interior soffit, BAL-40 capable.

panelspan.title: Panelspan® Wall Panels
panelspan.description: Pre-finished structural wall panels with FC or MgO surfaces — no extra cladding required.

panelcore.title: Panelcore® Sunroom & Coldroom Panels
panelcore.description: Steel-skinned insulated panels for sunrooms, enclosed outdoor living and controlled-temperature spaces — from year-round sunrooms to cold rooms and freezers.

alyspan.title: Alyspan® Structural Aluminium Beams & Posts
alyspan.description: Australian-designed structural aluminium patio beams, posts, connectors and brackets. 100x50 and 150x50 in 6063-T6, engineer-certified span tables to AS 1664 and AS 4055.
